data.name: Warlane
data.detailed_description:
Command. Adapt. Conquer.

Warlane is a fast-paced 1v1 strategy game where every match is a test of wits, timing, and adaptability. Draft units from a randomized hand, deploy them onto the battlefield, and outmaneuver your opponent in real-time to take down their King.

Draft and Deploy Each match presents you with a fresh hand of units. Choose wisely — the cards you're dealt change every game, so no two battles ever play out the same way.

Merge to Dominate Combine units on the field to forge powerful upgraded fighters. Knowing when to merge and when to swarm is the difference between victory and defeat.

Shape Your Army with Instincts Unlock Instincts mid-battle to give your entire army shared traits — speed, aggression, resilience, and more. Adapt your strategy on the fly as the fight evolves and force your opponent to rethink their approach.

Risk and Reward Spend everything on an early rush, or invest your gold to build a late-game economy? Warlane rewards both bold aggression and patient strategy — but only if you read your opponent right.

Pure 1v1. No Towers. Just You and the Enemy King. Strip away the clutter. Every match is a head-to-head duel where your decisions are the only thing standing between your King and defeat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
